fields.label: Executive Concept Note Abstract
fields.value: Anatolia Green Electric-Arc Steel & 120 MW Solar + BESS Decarbonization Project (Anatolia Clean Metallurgy A.Ş., Türkiye) requests $45,000,000 via EBRD's Senior Debt. Retrofitting a major Turkish steel rolling facility to 100% renewable-powered electric-arc furnace operation paired with 120 MW captive solar PV and 60 MWh lithium-iron-phosphate battery storage to achieve EU CBAM compliance. Contact [REDACTED_EMAIL_1] for technical annex. Climate Impact: 185,000 tCO2e/year avoided; 1,200 direct adaptation beneficiaries. Aligned with COP31 Antalya commitment (Green Economy Transition (GET) Strategy 2026–2030; €26B+ cumulative commitments in Türkiye; TIDIP & Kazakhstan JETP partner).
